info.name: Store Platform Capstone
info.description: Every flow goes through the Ocelot gateway (gatewayUrl). Run the folders in order with the 'Store Platform - local' environment, after docker compose up --build.

item.name: 1. Browse (public)
item.description: Anonymous browsing through the gateway. Also stores product ids used later.

exec: pm.test("returns active products only", () => { pm.expect(products.length).to.be.at.least(8); products.forEach(p => pm.expect(p.isActive).to.be.true); });
const bySku = sku => products.find(p => p.sku === sku);
pm.test("jacket has stock 1 or less (insufficient-stock demo)", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().find(s => s.sku === "AC-JACKET-VAR").quantityAvailable).to.be.at.most(1));

item.name: 2. Register and login
item.description: Tokens are saved into the environment by the test scripts.

exec: pm.test("lines carry a price snapshot", () => order.lines.forEach(l => pm.expect(l.unitPrice).to.be.above(0)));

item.name: Order is Confirmed with status history

exec: // Give the saga a few seconds to finish (events are processed asynchronously).
console.log("Order " + order.id + " is " + order.status, order.statusHistory.map(h => h.status + ": " + (h.reason || "")));

pm.test("history is Pending -> StockReserved -> PaymentCharged -> Confirmed", () => pm.expect(order.statusHistory.map(h => h.status)).to.eql(["Pending","StockReserved","PaymentCharged","Confirmed"]));

item.name: Failure after payment: refunded, released, Cancelled

exec: // Give the saga a few seconds to finish (events are processed asynchronously).
console.log("Order " + order.id + " is " + order.status, order.statusHistory.map(h => h.status + ": " + (h.reason || "")));
pm.test("payment was charged before compensation", () => pm.expect(order.statusHistory.map(h => h.status)).to.include("PaymentCharged"));

item.name: 5. Security at the gateway
item.description: 401 without a token, 403 with a Customer token (RouteClaimsRequirement role=Admin).

item.name: 6. Chaos and retry
item.description: Order calls Catalog through a resilience pipeline: exponential retry with jitter, timeouts and a circuit breaker.

exec: console.log("Look for 'Retrying Catalog call' in: docker compose logs order-api");

item.name: 7. Login rate limit
item.description: POST /identity/v1/auth/login is limited to 5 per minute (429).

request.description: The gateway allows 5 login attempts per minute per client address. Run this folder last; wait a minute before logging in again.

exec: pm.test("rate limited with a clear message after " + n + " attempts", () => pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.include("Too many login attempts"));
